page.layout: One page of text in verse, one block, with a running head above and a page number and signature at the foot. Margin marks on the right are ornaments and show-through, not notes.

main_text.p: Terras amicus lustrat Vllas ignibus Titan renidens pinguibus qua victimis, Et thure multo non meum quaerat lubens Placare numen: iste nostra respuens Edicta solus: quaeque cuncta gens probat Sequi recusans Vnus, ethereo patri Placere quaerit, atque quidquid imperet, Nil ambigens obtemperat: nec iudicat Quidquam graue, licet dura mandet sapius. Nam iussus ad arduum Moriia verticem Montis suum mox mox Isacum ducere. Illicque mactatum cremare, se via Commisit ecce, suamque celans coniugem Aras tepentes filij respergere. Parat cruore, torridosque adurere. Rogis tenelli secta membra corporis: Affectus illum patrius, qui pectori Defixus haeret intimo, atque coniugis Nato timentis lacrymas haud movent, neque Dura mala quae senes solent orbos sequi. Sed quidquid accidat, meis hac commodis Res cedet ultro. Namque si nihil pauens Abramus ipse filium mactet suum, Promissa Isaco facta quondam corruent: Nam mortuus semen beatum gignere Nequibit illud, regna quod vertet mea, Mortisque ahena vincla rumpens pallida, Et saevientis Tartari tyrannidem, Vita perennis aperiet [?]horas [?]Sias:

page.notes: Long s is printed as s throughout. Several words are doubtful, marked [?]. Decorative capital forms such as the Vllas and Vnus initials are read as V. The final line is partly unclear. Running head is in capitals as printed.
